article.story: JACKSONVILLE, Fla. -- — Hayden Wood had 26 points in Jacksonville’s 79-61 win over Kansas City on Monday. Wood also contributed six rebounds and three steals for the Dolphins (2-1). Jamie Phillips Jr. scored 18 points, going 7 of 12 from the floor, including 2 for 5 from 3-point range, and 2 for 4 from the line. Nehemiah Turner shot 4 of 8 from the field and 2 of 5 from the free-throw line to finish with 10 points. Jibbe Sicking led the way for the Roos (1-2) with 11 points. UMKC also got nine points and five assists from Jaylen Smith. Sebastian Hartmann finished with eight points and seven rebounds. Up next Jacksonville’s next game is Monday against Georgia on the road. UMKC squares off against Florida A&M on Wednesday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
